notes.title: [UPDATE] v1.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi all!


It’s been quite a long journey, but we’ve finally reached the final major update for Quickie: A Love Hotel Story! We’re releasing it a few hours before we exit Early Access in case of any last minute issues or bugs that may arise.



!! If you encounter any bugs or issues, PLEASE let us know by using our Bug Reports thread in discussions, on our Discord or email us at bugs@oppaigames.com !!



Skip to the highlights below to get a TL;DR of all that was added in this build!


New Hotel Manager Gameplay

▶ New Guest Types
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798849/28c09e4a19d1fed1fdb6697e433f9ea69a51fae7.png"]

As you manage new hotels, you’ll slowly be introduced to new Guest Types: Impatient Type, Picky Type, Filthy Type and Slow Type. These new guest types add new challenges to the shifts as you play, so make sure you look at who you are allocating!

▶ Services Overhaul
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798849/9eb76bb6592308033eda95149318db3796469036.png"]

Services and their upgrades will now be shared across all hotels! We hope this will make the newer hotels feel less like a step back as you unlock and build new hotels. Each service now offers a perk and when a guest makes a request, you can choose which service perk you’d like to obtain!

▶ New Star Rewards + Hotel Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798849/b1e0417d9e639a3cbd2b6996e1c2389329115542.png"]

Janitors, Ticket Machines and the special new ‘ALL’ type hotel rooms will be unlocked as you meet Star goals and earn hotel stars!

▶ Welcome Button
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798849/602323dcf1d05310b28abb76f6b8949f360b7717.png"]

You can now let in new guests quickly with the new Bell Button. We hope this will help players choose the pace they desire when playing the hotel management game!

▶ Quality of Life Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798849/e1e7f6c56895ef81413e20ed372fdec8332d6fc3.png"]

We also tried to add some quality of life additions including: entering a new hotel gives a cash reward to help with building up the new hotel, search bar and filter has been added to the Build Rooms menu, added new ‘ALL Type’ rooms and added newer and sexier SFX!




BUILD  v0.40 HIGHLIGHTS

♥ Quickie Hotel Manager
We’ve focused most of our energy this build in trying to make Quickie Hotel Manager a better experience overall, without changing too much of what players are already familiar with. We highly recommend old players to look at the Managing Quickie Love Hotels Tutorial in the Tutorials menu, available in the pause menu. A detailed list of the main changes can be found below. We hope you all enjoy the new and improved Quickie Hotel Manager! 

♥ New Language Support - Russian and Spanish
We’re very happy to announce the addition of Spanish and Russian language support in Q:LHS!

♥ New Voice Setting - Japanese Voice Actresses (H-Scenes Only)
After many requests, we’ve finally introduced an option to listen to Japanese voice actresses during h-scenes! These new Japanese voices are limited to ONLY the main 8 female love interests and can ONLY be heard in the adult scenes when playing the game. All other characters will not be voiced with this setting.

GENERAL
New language support: Russian and Spanish.

New Japanese Voice setting added to the game (can be adjusted in the options).

Money (¥) is now earned when you are sent home early and don’t have a Blueprint to read.

New 3D character models: Maki, Yamato and Shin.

New images added in Sara, Reika and Satomi Emperor room invites.

Added more gifts the love interests like.

Main menu updated.

General quality of life UI improvements.

General bug fixes.

QUICKIE HOTEL MANAGER
Service overhaul. Service upgrades are shared with all hotels.

Ticket Machines and Janitors are now rewarded when specific stars are earned.

Daily Earnings are now based on the hotel star rating.

Added a search filter in the Build menu.

Added new Star rewards menu.

Added a button to welcome guests immediately.

Guest service requests are now generic, allowing any service to fulfill a guest’s service request.

New types of guests introduced in each new hotel location: Impatient, Picky, Filthy and Slow.

Added a money reward when entering a new hotel to help build the new hotel immediately.

Some hotel rooms are now earned when opening a new hotel.

Removed Blueprints from Gacha machines to make it easier to collect Blueprints.

UI updates to help with gameplay feedback and clarity.

Updated some SFX.

New rooms: Harajuku Single, Harajuku Double, Shibuya Single and Shibuya Double.

Some rooms are now type All.

General bug fixes and balancing.

notes.title: [PATCH] 'My One and Only' Achievement Update
notes.content:
Hey all!

We’ve been seeing some discussions arising around one of our recently added achievements, ‘My One and Only’, and noticed it’s been causing a bit of a stir. 

We initially added the new achievements to reward players who explored all the options with ‘Casanova’, but also wanted to recognize the rare player who remained loyal to their favourite waifu with ‘My One and Only’.

We didn't anticipate that adding this achievement later in the Early Access development might have upset some players. Our intention was solely to add achievements for enjoyment and to encourage diverse playing styles. But we hadn't realized how important collecting all the achievements was for many of you.

As a result, we’ve updated the game (v0.39.2) with a new way to achieve the last achievement WITHOUT needing to start a new game.

How To Get the ‘My One and Only’ Achievement:

 End the game with ONE love interest at 5 hearts (Strong Bond). 
 OR end the game and break up with ALL the other love interests you have created a Strong Bond with.

Concerning a Harem Ending:
I know many of you were hoping to see this feature, but unfortunately, it wasn't part of our original plan for the game. It was an artistic decision we made for Quickie some time ago, and while we understand it might be disappointing for some, we hope you can respect our choice :) 

Thank you all for the ongoing support, love, and feedback! We look forward to releasing our final update with all missing assets, polish and some much-needed tweaks and balancing for the hotel manager game. You can expect this sometime in Q2. 

If you've already unlocked the ‘My One and Only’ achievement before this update, or if you aim to get it soon, who is your One and Only? Let us know in the comments! ♥

notes.title: NEWS: Update v0.39 Coming April 15th!
notes.content:
Hey all,

We hope you’ve all been enjoying the start of 2025! 

The Oppai Team has been working tirelessly to bring v0.39 to life, aiming for a quality we can be proud of. This release is our most ambitious to date! However, despite our best efforts, it turned out to be a bigger job than anticipated, making it too difficult to complete by the end of this month. The new release date for v0.39 is set for April 15th 2025.

We are still committed and confident that full release (v1.0) will still be in Q2.

notes.title: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story - v0.34 Roadmap + Halloween!
notes.content:
Hey All!

After every update, we post a quick road map highlighting what you can expect in the update to follow. We’re trying something new over the next month, so Q:LHS v0.34 will be handled a bit differently than usual. 

We tend to get a lot of people asking whether we have any intentions of releasing our older short novel Flash games on Steam, but we’ve generally been opposed to the idea due to the games not originally being made with Steam in mind. However, due to the amount of interest, we thought we’d try to spend some time remastering one and with Halloween just around the corner… we decided we’d remaster Quickie: Halloween Special!

Over the next month, we’ll be working on remastering Quickie: Halloween Special (renamed to Quickie: Fantasy Adventure), aiming to have it released on Patreon and Steam [strike]by Halloween (October 31st)[/strike] for FREE! We hope both old and new players enjoy this classic but updated Quickie game on Steam :)

After development on the Quickie: Halloween Special remaster is done, work on Q:LHS will quickly resume. For Q:LHS v0.34, our main focus will be finishing Toshiko’s story with her Heart 5 event!

⮞ [strike]October[/strike] November 2023: Quickie: Fantasy Adventure is scheduled to release at the [strike]end of October[/strike] beginning of November. Please stay tuned for an announcement about this release!

⮞ November 2023: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story v0.34 is scheduled to release on the last day of November.


Q:LHS v0.34 Roadmap

♥ TOSHIKO HEART 5 EVENT (WITH H-SCENES)

We'll be finishing Toshiko’s story by adding her Heart 5 event in v0.34! Her Heart event will include h-scenes and will make Toshiko the fourth love interest to have their story complete.

♥ ARIA MECHA ROOM HOTEL INVITE

We'll be adding a hotel invite for Aria in a new Mecha room!

♥ PROFESSOR BELMONT WORK INVITES

Professor Belmont will be added as an option to be invited to work (Ramen-san and My Whiskey). The UI for inviting girls will also be redone to make it easier to pick exactly which girl you want to invite.

Thanks!

♥

notes.title: [UPDATE] v0.33 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey all!

We're finally finishing the Professor's story by adding her Heart 4 and Heart 5 events, as well as 2 new hangouts with her! It's been a long time since we've returned to her story, so we were excited to make her our 3rd character to have their storylines complete. 

We also finally added a long requested customization feature, where you can adjust your name, appearance and voice! You can find this feature by clicking on the CUSTOMIZE button in your apartment.

Aria Mecha Invite delayed again to v0.34!
We've unfortunately had to delay Aria's Mecha invite again to v0.34 due to the large scope of Professor Belmont's story and scenes. We're very sorry to Aria fans waiting for this invite, we really didn't want to delay her scene again, but we may have gotten a little ambitious with Professor Belmont's scenes - which we hope you can still enjoy too! Completing this scene will become a priority for us in v0.34.

If you have any issues, find any bugs or just want to chat - you can contact us on our Discord channel! We're usually around if we're awake :D

You can read about what changes you can expect in this new build below:

notes.title: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story - v0.30 Roadmap

What a year it has been! Quickie: A Love Hotel Story has officially been available on Steam Early Access for a year now and it's still feels insane to us how many of you took the time to play our little game this year. notes.title: Update v0.29 Delayed + Halloween Update!
notes.content:
Hi all!

Content in Q:LHS v0.29 has been progressing, but not as well as we hoped in the recent months as the team has been hit with illness and dealt with a house move. We’re incredibly sorry that this has caused us to take a little longer than expected, but we’ll be delaying the release until late November. (A roadmap on what you may expect in v0.29 can be found here)

However, as we don’t want you to go without any content this month - we will be adding a small but sexy Halloween update on October 31st (PST)! This update will include a new hotel room and hotel invite scene with Reika.

We apologize again for the delay as we know some of you were looking forward to seeing the end to Reika’s story… but we really hope you enjoy the Halloween update at the end of this month and that v0.29 will be worth the wait! We think it will be ;)

TL;DR

 Quickie: A Love Hotel Story v0.29 will be delayed till late November.
 Halloween Update will drop on October 31st which includes a new hotel room and new hotel invite with Reika.


Thank you all for your patience and we hope you’re all safe and well!

♥

Oppai Games Team

notes.title: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story - v0.26 Roadmap

Feel free to skip to the tl;dr at the bottom for highlights.

[hr][/hr]

♥ SATOMI LAST HEART EVENT
We're finishing Satomi's main story this build by adding her last Heart event (Heart event 5)! This will be a big heart event with h-scene(s), but we're looking forward to finally completing a girl's heart events :)


♥ ARIA HEART 2 EVENT
Along with Satomi's Heart 5, we'll be continuing Aria's story with her Heart 2 event. This will get her closer to being able to invite her to the hotel.


♥ MORE HANGOUTS
At least one more hangout will be added with Satomi, which will need to be completed to unlock her Heart 5 event. More hangouts will be added dependent on time.


♥ MORE VOICE ACTORS
We'll be looking to expand our cast by filling in main story and side character roles. More information on this will be announced later.


♥ MORE HOTEL GUEST ANIMATIONS (HOTEL MANAGER GAME)
New hotel guest animations in the Hotel Manager Game have been highly requested and we'll finally be adding some more! We'll be aiming to add at least one animation each update to start creating some diversity of animations seen in the Hotel Manager Game. 

TL;DR - WHAT'S BEING ADDED?
 Satomi's Heart 5 event with h-scene(s).
 Aria's Heart 2 event.
 At least one more hangout.
 Starting to fill out side character voice acting roles.
 New guest animations in the Hotel Manager Game.
 Adding some missing 3D models and 2D busts.
 General Game updates/polish/bug fixing.


Thanks!

♥

notes.title: [UPDATE] v0.25.1 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey all!

Thanks so much for your support and patience while we worked on our first update for Steam!

As mentioned in our v0.25 Roadmap, this build is a bit smaller than our usual due to the Steam release and our Holiday season break. However, we hope you still enjoy the new content and our first hotel scene with Victoria! ♥

If you have any issues, find any bugs or just want to chat - you can contact us on our Discord channel! We're usually around if we're awake :D

You can read about what changes you can expect in this new build below:

CHANGELOG
BUILD v0.25 & v0.25.1 HIGHLIGHTS

♥ Victoria Availability

Victoria is now available for gifting and inviting to the hotel after her Heart 1 event! She can be found in Roppongi outside the hotel on the far Eastside after completing her Heart 1 event.

♥ New Hotel Invite: Victoria in Maid & Master Room

Victoria’s Maid & Master Room Quickie Love Hotel Invite is now available (her first invite in the game!). You can access this new invite from the Quickie Love Hotel’s Invite menu (make sure you have the Onsen room in your Hotel!).

♥ New Hangout: Satomi at Fujino Books

A new Satomi hangout at Fujino Books has been added! It’s available by talking to Satomi after completing her Heart 4 event.

♥ New Part-Time Job: My Whiskey

A part-time job position is now available at My Whiskey! It's unlocked after completing Mai Heart 2.


GENERAL UPDATES

 Victoria is now available for gifting and inviting after completing her Heart 1 event!
 Updated the day transition UI.
 Added: My Whiskey job minigame (Unlocked after completing Mai Heart 2).
 Added: new loading screen before the Main Menu.
 Added: Touma bust.
 Update Traditional and Simplified Chinese translations.
 Chance to get blueprints in Gachas now increases the more you play.
 Optimized loading times.


STORY UPDATES

 Added: Victoria’s Maid & Master hotel invite.
 Added: Satomi’s Fujino Books invite.
 Added: Victoria’s casual wear 3D model and 2D bust.


QUICKIE HOTEL MANAGER UPDATES

 While moving rooms, you can now chain move rooms by placing a room on top of another to pick the new room up to move.
 Escape key and Right click now backs out of most menus/popups (when not doing the Tutorial).


BUG FIXES

 Fixed rooms overlapping in the hotel.
 Fixed UI issues during the hotel tutorial.
 Fixed environment movement that can occur when browsing shops.
 Fixed instances where the pause menu would be completely grayed out when not intended.
 Fixed Escape key and Right click not working as intended.
 Fixed My Whiskey fast travel.
 Fixed MC crowd in Shibuya.
 Fixed Gallery bug with Victoria’s Maid & Master room invite.
 Fixed cases where the Family Room blueprint wasn’t available if you skipped the introduction.

notes.title: Quickie: A Love Hotel Story - v0.25 Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey All!

After every build, we post a quick road map highlighting what you can expect in the build to follow.

This build will be a bit smaller than our usual builds due to the Steam release and Holiday season break this month, but there will be new h-scene content that we're keen to get back into making!

Below are all the changes we're hoping to get done this build:


 Victoria's first hotel invite.
 Making Victoria available for gifting after her first heart event.
 At least one new hangout.
 My Whiskey part-time job.
 Further QHM improvements.
 Ongoing work to add missing 3D characters.

We're aiming to release v0.25 sometime in February for Steam, so stay tuned!

♥

notes.title: Releasing on Early Access December 17th!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798849/068965b357ee91320c69cd0a5a97b43ff333e74e.gif

We're excited to announce that Quickie: A Love Hotel Story will finally release in Early Access this Friday 17th December!

Quickie: A Love Hotel Story will be a one-time purchase of $19.99 USD and will have access to all scenes and content. There will be Steam achievements, Steam cloudsaves and you will get all future build updates. The game will also release with language support for Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.

Thanks so much for your patience and support. We really hope you enjoy the game! 

See you all Friday! ♥
